|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 3, in date order). It is the current text.
* '''Original''' ([[Working Much More Closely]], 9 November 2020): Original: the image at the set's official release (9 November 2020). Players Committee card image, 9 November 2020: 0 side [[:File:V13-D-workingmuchmoreclosely-20201109.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Working%20Much%20More%20Closely.gif Holotable commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards”], no mark). Text: “If you have two Crimson Dawn characters in battle together, draw destiny and subtract that amount from attrition against you. OR ▼ up to two Crimson Dawn characters. OR Cancel a hologram.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Working Much More Closely (Errata)]], 2 January 2023): Players Committee card image, 2 January 2023: 0 side [[:File:V13-D-workingmuchmoreclosely-20230102.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/fba281d/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/hires/workingmuchmoreclosely.png Holotable commit fba281d “Remastered Sets 13 and P, and 1 AI fix.”], no mark). Text: “If you have two Crimson Dawn characters in battle together, draw destiny and subtract that amount from attrition against you. OR ▼ up to two Crimson Dawn characters. OR Cancel a hologram.” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details: the margin note “Holonet Transmission” became “HoloNet Transmission”, and the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” was added; the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 29 December 2024): Players Committee card image, 29 December 2024: 0 side [[:File:V13-D-workingmuchmoreclosely.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/hires/workingmuchmoreclosely.png Holotable commit efc26cd “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”], mark “E1”). Text: “Deploy on table. Your non-[Dagobah] holograms are canceled. While present with an opponent's Jedi, Maul is defense value +2 and immune to attrition. Once per game, if [Set 13] Maul on table, may ▼ Qi'ra. If Maul just lost, place Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' the card became an Effect (was a Lost Interrupt) with new game text: “Deploy on table. Your non-[Dagobah] holograms are canceled. While present with an opponent's Jedi, Maul is defense value +2 and immune to attrition. Once per game, if [Set 13] Maul on table, may ▼ Qi'ra. If Maul just lost, place Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter.]” The card prints the errata mark “E1”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
